items.title: Public observation of early voted ballot processing for the November 3, 2026 State Election
items.summary: Boston's Election Department is removing early voted ballots from their envelopes and running them through a tabulator at City Hall, Room 801, and the public can watch. Processing runs October 26 through November 3, 2026, mostly 8:30 am to 5:30 pm, and continues on Election Day from 8 am until complete.
